axis_convention: raster pixels of the archival scan, origin top-left, x right, y down; face1 = west (low-x) flank, face2 = east (high-x) flank of the crossing avenue

controls.why_not_one_block_off: Sheet 39 prints the 21st St even run 620-624 immediately west of the gap and the Ave G run 2022-2028 down its west flank; sheet 43 prints the odd runs 621/623 vs 701-707 across the gap and Ave G runs 2102-2112 (west flank) / 2101-2111 (east flank).
